verdict.rationale: mise documents a direct migration path from asdf: it reads `.tool-versions` as-is, can still use asdf plugins, and reads idiomatic version files like `.node-version` and `.ruby-version` once enabled. Community users confirm it works as a drop-in asdf replacement and report switching from pyenv/nvm/RVM. missing for 10: an explicit import/conversion command that rewrites incumbent configs into mise.toml, documented migration guides for non-asdf incumbents (e.g. Makefile/just tasks)
